newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia TABs 2000 avg BBSW minus 15.07 b.p..
newsitem.headline: Australia TABs 2000 avg BBSW minus 15.07 b.p..

text.p: Australia's A$300 million October 2000 Treasury adjustable rate bonds (TABs) tender produced an average margin to the bank bill swap reference mid-rate (BBSW) of minus 15.07 basis points, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said.

Oct 2000 AS300 million A$300 million -15.07 bp -15.50/15.05 bp
